ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (1) Alif, Lām, Rā.[668] These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
enNotes: [668]- See footnote to 2:1.
tr: Alif lām rā, tilka āyātul-kitābi waqurʾānim mubīn

ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
en: (2) Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish[669] that they had been Muslims.
enNotes: [669]- On the Day of Judgement or at the time of death.
tr: Rubamā yawaddul-ladhīna kafarū law kānū muslimīn

ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (3) Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
tr: Dharhum yaʾkulū wayatamattaʿū wayulhihimul-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūn

ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
en: (4) And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
tr: Wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābum maʿlūm

ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
en: (5) No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
tr: Mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastaʾkhirūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
en: (6) And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.[670]
enNotes: [670]- Literally, "possessed by jinn."
tr: Waqālū yā ayyuhal-ladhī nuzzila ʿalayhidh-dhikru innaka lamajnūn

ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: (7) Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
tr: Lawmā taʾtīnā bil-malāʾikati in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn

ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
en: (8) We do not send down the angels except with truth;[671] and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
enNotes: [671]- i.e., with a message or, as the conclusion of the verse suggests, to carry out a promised punishment.
tr: Mā nunazzilul-malāʾikata illā bil-ḥaqqi wamā kānū idham munẓarīn

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
en: (9) Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
tr: Innā naḥnu nazzalnadh-dhikra waʾinnā lahū laḥāfiẓūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (10) And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
tr: Walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿil-awwalīn

ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (11) And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
tr: Wamā yaʾtīhim mir rasūlin illā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
en: (12) Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
tr: Kadhālika naslukuhū fī qulūbil-mujrimīn

ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (13) They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
tr: Lā yuʾminūna bihī waqad khalat sunnatul-awwalīn

ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
en: (14) And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
tr: Walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bābam minas-samāʾi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūn

ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
en: (15) They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
tr: Laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmum masḥūrūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
en: (16) And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
tr: Walaqad jaʿalnā fis-samāʾi burūjaw wazayyannāhā lin-nāẓirīn

ar: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
en: (17) And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
tr: Waḥafiẓnāhā min kulli shayṭānir rajīm

ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (18) Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
tr: Illā manistaraqas-samʿa faʾatbaʿahū shihābum mubīn

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
en: (19) And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
tr: Wal-arḍa madadnāhā waʾalqaynā fīhā rawāsiya waʾambatnā fīhā min kulli shayʾim mawzūn

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
en: (20) And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.[672]
enNotes: [672]- Allāh has put at your service other men and animals for which He provides. An additional meaning is that Allāh provides means for your living and for all other creatures as well.
tr: Wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha wamal lastum lahū birāziqīn

ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
en: (21) And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
tr: Waʾim min shayʾin illā ʿindanā khazāʾinuhū wamā nunazziluhū illā biqadarim maʿlūm

ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
en: (22) And We have sent the fertilizing winds[673] and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
enNotes: [673]- Causing precipitation in rainclouds or carrying pollen. Another meaning is "pregnant winds," i.e., those carrying rainclouds.
tr: Waʾarsalnar-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa faʾanzalnā minas-samāʾi māʾan faʾasqaynākumūh, wamā antum lahū bikhāzinīn

ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
en: (23) And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.[674]
enNotes: [674]- Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) remains after all creation has passed away.
tr: Waʾinnā lanaḥnu nuḥyī wanumītu wanaḥnul-wārithūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
en: (24) And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
tr: Walaqad ʿalimnal-mustaqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalimnal-mustaʾkhirīn

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (25) And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
tr: Waʾinna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum, innahū ḥakīmun ʿalīm

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
en: (26) And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr: Walaqad khalaqnal-insāna min ṣalṣālim min ḥamaʾim masnūn

ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
en: (27) And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
tr: Wal-jānna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāris-samūm

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
en: (28) And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr: Waʾidh qāla rabbuka lil-malāʾikati innī khāliqum basharam min ṣalṣālim min ḥamaʾim masnūn

ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
en: (29) And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,[675] then fall down to him in prostration."
enNotes: [675]- The element of life and soul which Allāh created for that body, not His own spirit or part of Himself (as some mistakenly believe).
tr: Faʾidhā sawwaytuhū wanafakhtu fīhi mir rūḥī faqaʿū lahū sājidīn

ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
en: (30) So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
tr: Fasajadal-malāʾikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn

ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
en: (31) Except Iblees;[676] he refused to be with those who prostrated.
enNotes: [676]- Who was of the jinn. See 18:50.
tr: Illā iblīs, abā ay yakūna maʿas-sājidīn

ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
en: (32) [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
tr: Qāla yā iblīsu mā laka allā takūna maʿas-sājidīn

ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
en: (33) He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
tr: Qāla lam akul liʾasjuda libasharin khalaqtahū min ṣalṣālim min ḥamaʾim masnūn

ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
en: (34) [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it,[677] for indeed, you are expelled.
enNotes: [677]- Your position in the heavens.
tr: Qāla fakhruj minhā faʾinnaka rajīm

ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
en: (35) And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
tr: Waʾinna ʿalaykal-laʿnata ilā yawmid-dīn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
en: (36) He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
tr: Qāla rabbi faʾanẓirnī ilā yawmi yubʿathūn

ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
en: (37) [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr: Qāla faʾinnaka minal-munẓarīn

ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
en: (38) Until the Day of the time well-known."
tr: Ilā yawmil-waqtil-maʿlūm

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (39) [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
tr: Qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī laʾuzayyinanna lahum fil-arḍi walaʾughwiyannahum ajmaʿīn

ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
en: (40) Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
tr: Illā ʿibādaka minhumul-mukhlaṣīn

ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
en: (41) [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
tr: Qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mustaqīm

ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
en: (42) Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
tr: Inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sulṭānun illā manittabaʿaka minal-ghāwīn

ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (43) And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
tr: Waʾinna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīn

ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
en: (44) It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
tr: Lahā sabʿatu abwāb, likulli bābim minhum juzʾum maqsūm

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
en: (45) Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
tr: Innal-muttaqīna fī jannātiw waʿuyūn

ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
en: (46) [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
tr: Udkhulūhā bisalāmin āminīn

ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
en: (47) And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment,[678] [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
enNotes: [678]- See footnote to 7:43.
tr: Wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikhwānan ʿalā sururim mutaqābilīn

ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
en: (48) No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
tr: Lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabuw wamā hum minhā bimukhrajīn

ar: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (49) [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
tr: Nabbiʾ ʿibādī annī anal-ghafūrur-raḥīm

ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
en: (50) And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
tr: Waʾanna ʿadhābī huwal-ʿadhābul-alīm

ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
en: (51) And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
tr: Wanabbiʾhum ʿan ḍayfi ibrāhīm

ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
en: (52) When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
tr: Idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāmā, qāla innā minkum wajilūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
en: (53) [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
tr: Qālū lā tawjal innā nubashshiruka bighulāmin ʿalīm

ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
en: (54) He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
tr: Qāla abashshartumūnī ʿalā am massaniyal-kibaru fabima tubashshirūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
en: (55) They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
tr: Qālū bashsharnāka bil-ḥaqqi falā takum minal-qāniṭīn

ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
en: (56) He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
tr: Qāla wamay yaqnaṭu mir raḥmati rabbihī illaḍ-ḍāllūn

ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (57) [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
tr: Qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhal-mursalūn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
en: (58) They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
tr: Qālū innā ursilnā ilā qawmim mujrimīn

ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (59) Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
tr: Illā āla lūṭ, innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīn

ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
en: (60) Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.[679]
enNotes: [679]- For having collaborated with the evildoers.
tr: Illamraʾatahū qaddarnā innahā laminal-ghābirīn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (61) And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
tr: Falammā jāʾa āla lūṭinil-mursalūn

ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
en: (62) He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
tr: Qāla innakum qawmum munkarūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
en: (63) They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
tr: Qālū bal jiʾnāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūn

ar: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
en: (64) And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
tr: Waʾataynāka bil-ḥaqqi waʾinnā laṣādiqūn

ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
en: (65) So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
tr: Faʾasri biʾahlika biqiṭʿim minal-layli wattabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥaduw wamḍū ḥaythu tuʾmarūn

ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
en: (66) And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
tr: Waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālikal-amra anna dābira hāʾulāʾi maqṭūʿum muṣbiḥīn

ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
en: (67) And the people of the city came rejoicing.[680]
enNotes: [680]- At the news of Lot's visitors.
tr: Wajāʾa ahlul-madīnati yastabshirūn

ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
en: (68) [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
tr: Qāla inna hāʾulāʾi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūn

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
en: (69) And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
tr: Wattaqullāha walā tukhzūn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (70) They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
tr: Qālū awalam nanhaka ʿanil-ʿālamīn

ar: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
en: (71) [Lot] said, "These are my daughters[681] - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
enNotes: [681]- i.e., the women of his community who were lawful for marriage.
tr: Qāla hāʾulāʾi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīn

ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: (72) By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
tr: Laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūn

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
en: (73) So the shriek[682] seized them at sunrise.
enNotes: [682]- See footnote to 11:67.
tr: Faʾakhadhathumuṣ-ṣayḥatu mushriqīn

ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
en: (74) And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
tr: Fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā waʾamṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratam min sijjīl

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
en: (75) Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil lil-mutawassimīn

ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
en: (76) And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
tr: Waʾinnahā labisabīlim muqīm

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (77) Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyatal lil-muʾminīn

ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
en: (78) And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
tr: Waʾin kāna aṣḥābul-aykati laẓālimīn

ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (79) So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
tr: Fantaqamnā minhum, waʾinnahumā labiʾimāmim mubīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: (80) And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr[683] [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
enNotes: [683]- The valley of stone.
tr: Walaqad kadhdhaba aṣḥābul-ḥijril-mursalīn

ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
en: (81) And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
tr: Waʾātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿriḍīn

ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
en: (82) And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
tr: Wakānū yanḥitūna minal-jibāli buyūtan āminīn

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
en: (83) But the shriek seized them at early morning,
tr: Faʾakhadhathumuṣ-ṣayḥatu muṣbiḥīn

ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: (84) So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
tr: Famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
en: (85) And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
tr: Wamā khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqq, waʾinnas-sāʿata laʾātiyatun faṣfaḥiṣ-ṣafḥal-jamīl

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (86) Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
tr: Inna rabbaka huwal-khallāqul-ʿalīm

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
en: (87) And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses][684] and the great Qur’ān.
enNotes: [684]- Referring to Sūrah al-Fātiḥah.
tr: Walaqad ātaynāka sabʿam minal-mathānī wal-qurʾānal-ʿaẓīm

ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (88) Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
tr: Lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihī azwājam minhum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wakhfiḍ janāḥaka lil-muʾminīn

ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: (89) And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
tr: Waqul innī anan-nadhīrul-mubīn

ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
en: (90) Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators[685]
enNotes: [685]- Those who separated from the teachings of their prophets. Another meaning is "As We sent down [punishment] on the sworn opponents [to Allāh's message]."
tr: Kamā anzalnā ʿalal-muqtasimīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
en: (91) Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.[686]
enNotes: [686]- Accepting part and rejecting part according to their own inclinations.
tr: Al-ladhīna jaʿalul-qurʾāna ʿiḍīn

ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (92) So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
tr: Fawarabbika lanasʾalannahum ajmaʿīn

ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (93) About what they used to do.
tr: ʿAmmā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: (94) Then declare what you are commanded[687] and turn away from the polytheists.[688]
enNotes:
[687]- The implication is "Thereby you will distinguish or separate the disbelievers from the believers."
[688]- Any who persist in association of others with Allāh.
tr: Faṣdaʿ bimā tuʾmaru waʾaʿriḍ ʿanil-mushrikīn

ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
en: (95) Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
tr: Innā kafaynākal-mustahziʾīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (96) Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
tr: Al-ladhīna yajʿalūna maʿallāhi ilāhan ākhar, fasawfa yaʿlamūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
en: (97) And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
tr: Walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūn

ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
en: (98) So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
tr: Fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakum minas-sājidīn

ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
en: (99) And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
tr: Waʿbud rabbaka ḥattā yaʾtiyakal-yaqīn
